T: Defrosted in 2032. Still wants a proper feed.
D: A cop from 1996 is defrosted in a polite future where every restaurant belongs to the same taco chain.
P: Serve the mains when Spartan goes to the fancy future fast food dinner.
S: Boiled conchiglie fried until crisp, tossed in flaky salt and chilli
Shell-shaped pasta (conchiglie) boiled, dried, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in chilli salt. Three per person.
Future fast food chips and salsa
Fried corn tortilla chips with charred tomato jalapeño salsa
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C, salted, with a roasted tomato salsa (charred tomato, onion, garlic and jalapeño blitzed with lime).
M: Fine dining fish tacos with pico de gallo
Taco Bell is fine dining now. White tablecloths for the taco course

Lime and chilli grilled snapper in warm corn tortillas with pico de gallo, shredded cabbage and avocado crema. Mix the tomato, onion, chopped coriander and the juice of 1 lime for the pico de gallo. Blitz the avocado with the sour cream and a squeeze of lime for the crema. Rub the fish with the chilli, cumin, oil and salt and grill until just cooked, then flake. Warm the tortillas and fill with cabbage, fish, pico and crema.
Thick seared chuck patties with fried onions and melted cheddar
Big chuck patty seared hard with fried onions, cheddar and barbecue sauce on a toasted bun. Spartan says it's the best burger he's had in years.
W: Three colours of layered jelly cut into neat cubes, with a little whipped cream
Layered jelly: three flavours of jelly set one on top of the other in a slab tin, cut into perfect cubes, served on a white plate.
K: Cucumber, mint, lime and elderflower topped with sparkling water, no alcohol

Muddled cucumber and mint with elderflower cordial and fresh lime, topped with chilled sparkling water and served in coupes with a cucumber ribbon. Muddle half a Lebanese cucumber, chopped, with 8 mint leaves and the juice of 1 lime in a jug. Add 80ml elderflower cordial and stir. Strain into 4 coupe glasses over a small ice cube each. Top with 600ml cold sparkling water. Shave thin cucumber ribbons with a peeler and fold one into each glass.

Fry the sliced onions in oil until golden.
Sear the patties hard on a hot grill on both sides.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the onions up to 1 day ahead, chilled; grill the mushrooms and haloumi and build on the night

steps.text: Fry the sliced onions in half the oil until golden.
Sear the mushrooms in the rest of the oil on a hot grill until tender, and grill the haloumi until golden.
Melt a slice of cheddar on each mushroom.
Toast the buns and stack with haloumi, mushroom, onions and barbecue sauce.

veg.n: Fine dining cauliflower tacos with pico de gallo
veg.make_ahead: Make the pico and crema up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Mix the tomato, onion, chopped coriander and the juice of 1 lime for the pico de gallo.
Blitz the avocado with the sour cream and a squeeze of lime for the crema.
Toss the cauliflower with the chilli, cumin, oil and salt and roast at 220°C until charred.
Warm the tortillas and fill with cabbage, cauliflower, pico and crema.
Make each jelly one at a time, adding extra gelatine to the water.
Set each layer in the fridge before adding the next.
Turn out and cut into neat cubes.
Serve on a white plate with a little whipped cream.
Boil the berry juice with 1 tsp agar and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 minutes, then pour into a lined square tin.
Chill until firm.
Boil the pineapple juice with 1 tsp agar and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 minutes, cool for 5 minutes, pour gently over and chill until firm.
Do the same with the coconut milk and the rest of the agar and sugar, and chill until firm.
Turn out and cut into neat cubes.
Serve on a white plate with a little whipped cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Muddle the cucumber, mint, lime and cordial up to 4 hours ahead in the jug, chilled; strain over ice and top with sparkling water to serve

steps.text: Chop half the cucumber and muddle with the mint and lime juice in a jug. Add the cordial and stir.
Strain into coupe glasses over an ice cube each.
Top with sparkling water.
Shave the rest of the cucumber into ribbons and fold one into each glass.

s.note: Boiled conchiglie fried until crisp, tossed in flaky salt and chilli
s.how: Boil 150g conchiglie for 8 minutes, drain and dry well on a tea towel. Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and golden. Toss with flaky salt and chilli flakes while hot. Serve three per person to start, then the rest.

s.n: Future fast food chips and salsa
s.note: Fried corn tortilla chips with charred tomato jalapeño salsa
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Char 4 tomatoes, half an onion, 2 garlic cloves and a jalapeño under the grill. Blitz with the juice of a lime and salt. Serve in a bowl.

m.note: Thick seared chuck patties with fried onions and melted cheddar
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties and sear hard on a hot grill for 4 minutes a side. Fry 2 sliced onions until golden. Melt a slice of cheddar on each patty and stack on toasted buns with onions and barbecue sauce.

w.note: Three colours of layered jelly cut into neat cubes, with a little whipped cream
w.how: Make 3 packets of different coloured jelly crystals one at a time, using 2 gelatine leaves extra in each with 400ml water. Set each layer for an hour before adding the next. Turn out, cut into neat cubes and serve on a white plate with a little whipped cream.

d.note: Cucumber, mint, lime and elderflower topped with sparkling water, no alcohol
d.how: Muddle half a Lebanese cucumber, chopped, with 8 mint leaves and the juice of 1 lime in a jug. Add 80ml elderflower cordial and stir. Strain into 4 coupe glasses over a small ice cube each. Top with 600ml cold sparkling water. Shave thin cucumber ribbons with a peeler and fold one into each glass.
